title: X11: History-token watermarks survive store destroy/rebuild

description: After any reset, all three watermark consumers resume from a token belonging to a store that no longer exists - silently deaf (nothing to consume) or a full unbounded replay, with no error surfaced either way. Reset also never clears the widget snapshot cache, so erased tasks keep rendering with dangling deep links. Severity: High. Wave/Plan: Wave 3, plan 3b reset-propagation-safety. Sweep: cross-process.
